description: Defines the internal class ActivationData used in Orleans runtime to manage per-activation state, message processing, lifecycle, migration, deactivation, and request handling within the grain system.

classes.name: ActivationData
classes.description: Sealed internal class managing activation state, message processing, lifecycle, migration, deactivation, and request handling within Orleans grains.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Schedules a rehydration command with the message loop.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Schedules activation logic, including registration and lifecycle start.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Synchronously disposes of the activation, invokes async disposal.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Performs async cleanup, stops timers, deactivates grain, releases resources.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, routing responses and requests.

methods.name: InvokeIncomingRequest
methods.description: Invokes message processing through Orleans runtime client.

methods.name: CheckOverloaded
methods.description: Checks if activation request queues exceed configured limits.

methods.name: StartMigratingAsync
methods.description: Initiates migration process asynchronously, placing migration work in message loop.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Initiates deactivation and cleanup of activation.

methods.name: FinishDeactivating
methods.description: Completes deactivation process, calls grain lifecycle, handles migration forwarding.

methods.name: RunMessageLoop
methods.description: Main endless loop that processes pending operations and requests asynchronously.
